themes.title: Far-Right Stances on Foreign Conflicts and Security
themes.blurb: US peace envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travelled to Moscow and Kyiv to push a new proposal to end the war in Ukraine, drawing sharp reaction and skepticism from European politicians. Meanwhile, far-right parties in Sweden face political scrutiny over past pro-Russian ties, underscoring ongoing transnational debates around security alignments.

themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Populist and nationalist parties across Northern and Western Europe are leveraging voter dissatisfaction to reshape regional and national politics. In France, Marine Le Pen maintains a strong lead in presidential polls, while right-wing parties in Sweden and Norway campaign vigorously in municipal elections and challenge established power structures.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions

In Argentina, President Milei issued a decree reverting a national holiday's name back to 'Day of the Race', while the US executive branch defends religious expressions and plans grand national monuments.
